images.caption: Figure 2:Granularity of contemporary hallucination detection benchmarks. Resources use response-, span-, claim-, and multi-level formulations; span-level benchmarks further vary in character-, word-, entity-, and sentence- resolution. Each formulation supports different evaluation objectives and metrics.
Figure 4:Taxonomy of hallucination detectors by model access, signal source, detection mechanism, output granularity, and proxy transferability. Representative methods are listed in the final column.
